page.content:
Scottish tragedy of the thane, the witches, and Lady Macbeth.

How Macbeth connects

  • Creator: William Shakespeare — William Shakespeare wrote Macbeth.
  • Character: Macbeth (thane) — The thane is the title figure of Macbeth.
  • Character: Lady Macbeth — Lady Macbeth is the partner who plans Duncan's murder.
  • Work: First Folio — The First Folio is the first printing of Macbeth.
  • Concept: Shakespearean tragedy — Macbeth is a central Shakespearean tragedy.

What is Macbeth?

Macbeth is the shortest Folio tragedy: a thane who kills a king after the weird sisters prophesy, a wife who washes imagined blood, and a Scotland that answers with Birnam Wood.

Key threads lead to William Shakespeare, Macbeth (thane), Lady Macbeth, First Folio and Shakespearean tragedy.
